statusGroups.reason: ADRs 0004/0013/0038/0046/0080/0083: actual color editing through typed Color math, shared numeric/sliding channels, six spatial surfaces, local swatches, palette files, owned embedded popup and completed application-viewport sampling. Defaults, input, scene files and current Linux GPU/compatibility pixels execute; documented cold/tessellation/platform gates remain distinct.

The complete current color control API executes with numeric/hex/numeric-constructor editing, palettes, embedded UI and application sampler. Full typed color Expression/object/collection consumers need the separately accepted typed expression host; semantic accessibility and editor quick-load/settings retain their owners. Native external screen capture, OS picker and permission UI need their DisplayServer capabilities and are not application sampling. Shared CPU meshes approximate nonlinear gradients between samples; independent native windows, foreign platforms and owner acceptance are unverified.

Typed permanent Delete/gamepad X binding participates in default/reloaded InputMap; routed Delete removes a focused swatch. Physical controller delivery and platform variants retain the Input owner gate (ADR 0038).
ADR 0004: pinned ColorPicker.xml marks MODE_RAW deprecated in favor of MODE_LINEAR. Only Linear=2 is shipped, with actual linear RGB conversion; no obsolete alias.
